name: Luca
intro: Left on the street, found just in time, and now home in Milan.
before_body:
Luca's owners were travelling to watch a football match, so they put him out on the street and left. A pet supply shop nearby called us about him. By then he had been outside for about a week. He was sick with a cold and covered in fleas.

Luca is a gentle Scottish Fold who had no idea how to survive outside, and any passing car could have hit him. When we went to pick him up, a man nearby asked us to bring him back later so he could breed him with his own cat. We said no, and took Luca home.
care_body: We treated his cold, got rid of the fleas and nursed him back to health. Then we shared his story so the right family could find him.
after_body: Today Luca lives in Milan, Italy, safe, healthy and loved by his new family.
